explanation: Generalises erdosproblems.com/268 (d = 3) to every dimension d, following Kovač–Tao: the set of points (Σ_{n∈A} 1/(n+i))_{i<d}, over infinite A ⊆ ℕ with Σ 1/n < ∞, has nonempty interior. Allowing 0 ∈ A only adds points (via the junk value 1/0 = 0), so the set can only grow and the statement is implied by the positive-integer version. The d = 3 instance is the original problem (Kovač). Formal proof linked.
